loader.repository_safety_difference: torch.load uses weights_only=true; tensor and primitive metadata behavior is unchanged

study_stack.series_selection: For each slot, preserve test_series.csv row order, exclude already-used SeriesInstanceUID values, choose the first same-plane row with the preferred integer Fluid_Sensitive value when preference is 0 or 1, otherwise choose the first unused same-plane row.
study_stack.slice_order: Sort ascending by dot(ImagePositionPatient, cross(IOP row, IOP column)); use InstanceNumber when IOP/IPP are unavailable; unreadable headers use position 0.0 and spacing 0.5.
study_stack.sampling: For n>1, lo=int(n*0.06), hi=max(int(n*0.94)-1, lo), then np.linspace(lo, hi, slot_count).round().astype(int); for n=1 repeat index 0.
study_stack.short_series: Repeated source indices are retained; they are not deduplicated.
study_stack.pixel_spacing: Use only float(PixelSpacing[0]); default to 0.5 when absent or the header fails. During crop, nonpositive sampled spacing falls back to the median of successfully read header spacings.
study_stack.decode: pydicom.dcmread, apply_modality_lut, float32; MONOCHROME1 transforms pixels as max-pixel without adding the minimum.
study_stack.intensity: Compute one 2nd/98th percentile pair over all successfully decoded sampled pixels in the selected series, clip (pixel-lo)/(hi-lo+1e-6) to [0,1], spatially transform, multiply by 255 and truncate to uint8.
study_stack.crop: side=round(140/max(spacing,1e-3)), clamp side to min(source height,source width), center-crop a square with floor offsets; no padding.
study_stack.intermediate_resize: cv2.resize to 336x336 with INTER_AREA for both downsampling and upsampling.
study_stack.missing_slot: Leave every slice in the slot zero-filled.
study_stack.decode_failure: Leave that sampled slice zero-filled and continue.
study_stack.mask: A slice is valid only when the sum of its uint8 pixels is greater than zero.

windows.center_selection: Find nonzero mask indices. If fewer than three exist, substitute arange(min(3, depth)). Let lo=min(valid), hi=max(valid); candidates are every center from lo+1 through hi-1 whose neighbors remain within lo..hi. If empty, use max(1,min(floor((lo+hi)/2),depth-2)). Select 42 candidate positions with rounded linspace indices, retaining duplicates.
windows.slot_boundaries: Candidate centers are bounded only by the first and last valid stack slices. Zero-filled slots and slot boundaries are not excluded, so a three-slice window may cross them.
windows.scale: Convert uint8 to float32 and divide by 255 before model resize.

model.head: LayerNorm(1024); Linear(1024,256), Tanh, Dropout(0.2), Linear(256,12); softmax attention across 42 windows independently per target; per-target clsW dot pooled feature plus clsb.
model.attention_mask: No mask is passed to attention. Every constructed window participates.
model.cuda_precision: First attempt uses float16 autocast; any RuntimeError retries the study in float32 after emptying the CUDA cache. CPU uses float32.
model.determinism: Model is placed in eval mode; no test-time augmentation is used.

output.raw_study_failure: Initialize every target to 0.5 and retain those values when any study preprocessing or inference exception occurs.
output.submission_transform: Clip each arm's sigmoid outputs to [0,1], compute per-target percentile ranks with argsort(argsort(x))/(study_count-1), and use those ranks as final predictions. With one arm at weight 1.0 this is still applied.

reference_evidence.gold_metric_role: sanity/parity diagnostic only; checkpoint metadata does not establish an unbiased comparison cohort

source_discrepancies: The prose says a missing slot is skipped by the model, but executable code only uses the mask to bound center selection; zero-filled internal gaps still produce attention windows.
The prose describes a 140 mm PixelSpacing crop generally, but executable code uses PixelSpacing[0] for both square dimensions, clamps to the source image, and never pads.
The K_EVAL comment says every window position, but executable code samples exactly 42 rounded positions from all candidates and may omit or duplicate candidate centers.
Comments still mention three arms, K_EVAL=24, 0.914/0.915 live scores and an old 0.8893 result; executable ARMS contains one checkpoint and K_EVAL is 42.
The executable submission uses percentile ranks rather than the model's sigmoid probabilities directly.
unresolved_nonbehavioral_metadata: The notebook source does not print timm or OpenCV package versions. The Kaggle docker image digest is pinned instead.
